title: Giving Forecast model bundle v2
description: The refit pipeline writes it; the console calculator reads it (DE-021: one fixture, both lanes).

measures.description: Mentat measures the PAC model is applied to, side by side.

anchor_cycle_rule.description: Each industry x chamber names its anchor in share_models.*.anchors; the default is previous_cycle.

cycle_offset.description: Mentat anchor cycle = target cycle - cycle_offset

chained.description: true when the next cycle is projected through the open cycle (steps = 2)

lobbying_only.description: True for an industry offered for lobbying alone (Telecom, owner ruling 2026-10-08): it has no giving model, so the cycle model checks no general-giving step block and no IBIS growth path for it. Optional (absent = false: the industry is offered for giving and is checked); the writer emits it explicitly from the registry.

caveats.description: Scope and data caveats the console shows with the industry (OpenSecrets F09 = all insurance for property and casualty; IBISWorld current-year estimates). Optional: absent when there are none.

pac_model.description: Pooled values kept as in v1 (beta, ordinary_se, ordinary_p, critical_95); slopes[id].applied is what the calculator uses.

share_models.description: Only the two control models. Seats and the *_industry variants are not calculator models in v2.

unit.description: Log points of the lobbying level per +1 pp of the change in predicted growth (dg).

log_refit.description: The relative (log) lobbying model the calculator applies to Melange-LDA levels.

lobby_model.description: v1 dollar model kept as evidence (beta_million..CR2_p); log_refit is the calculator model.

p_rep.description: Mean P(Republican control) over the window, this market.
Mean P(Republican control) over the window, this market.

political_inputs.description: Expected-control inputs of anchor cycles that have no row in the model history (2024: Polymarket January-June only).

saved_outlook.description: 2026 prefill for the console. Seats are not part of v2. value is the primary (Polymarket) score x100.

industries.description: Per industry (bundle industry id), per horizon h = 1..3 years: the n persistence errors and their split-conformal 80th percentile of |log(level[t+h]) - log(level[t])|.

pooled.description: All LobbyView sectors pooled, per horizon: the 80th and 95th split-conformal percentiles of the persistence error.

lobby_persistence.description: Empirical persistence errors of the LobbyView lobbying level series (owner rulings 2026-10-08): how far the level of a year lies from the level h years earlier on the log scale, over the blind targets 2014-2023. The console adds them in quadrature to the in-year nowcast's blind error for the years after the nowcast year. Optional: a bundle without it leaves the later years without bands.

industries.description: Per industry; a model whose residual variance is pooled repeats the same block for each industry.

prediction.description: Prediction interval beside the coefficient interval (ruling 2026-09-30): point +/- crit*sqrt(v_coef + steps*sigma2).

applied_slope.description: The slope the calculator applies to this industry under the rule the refit picked. R0 pooled, R1 own, R2 DerSimonian-Laird blend.

anchor_rule.description: The anchor is chosen per industry and chamber (anchors[id].anchor); previous_cycle is the default.

anchors.description: One entry per industry that has the control capability.

share_model.description: A calculator share model. application "pooled": the top-level pooled fit (terms, beta, covariance) carries every term, including the focal Forecast slope. application "offset": the non-focal terms come from `offset` and the focal slope per industry from slopes[id].applied (variance = dx_o V_o dx_o + dF^2 se^2).

evidence_model.description: Kept as evidence only. Seat regressions are listed here with calculator:false ("no signal"); the calculator never reads them.

sensitivity.description: Score x100 on the other bases (sensitivities).

anchor_backtest.description: Mean absolute error in share percentage points of the calculator path under this anchor, for this industry and chamber: leave-one-election-out and chronological backtests (no leakage), applied slope rule.

anchor.description: The anchor the calculator uses for this industry and chamber. previous_cycle: Mentat's cycle A = open cycle - 2, the next cycle chained (steps = 2). same_phase: Mentat's cycle of the same phase (open cycle - 4 for the open cycle, open cycle - 2 for the next one), one step each.

slope_rule.description: The slope rule both anchors were backtested under (the rule the auto-pick chose for this chamber).

min_gain.description: RF$RULE_MIN_GAIN: same_phase is chosen only when its MAE is at least this fraction below previous_cycle in every backtest design.

same_phase_gain.description: 1 - MAE(same_phase) / MAE(previous_cycle) per design; positive = same_phase is better.

prediction.description: The anchored-step residual block of each anchor (previous_cycle: pairs (t-2, t); same_phase: pairs (t-4, t)). share_models.*.prediction.industries[id] repeats the chosen one.

anchor_choice.description: Owner ruling 2026-09-30: the anchor of each share model x industry x chamber is auto-picked by backtest; same_phase replaces the default previous_cycle only when it beats it by min_gain in every design.

cycle_step.description: The anchored-step residual block of one industry: df = pairs - 1, critical_95 = qt(.975, df), sigma2 = the step variance.

cycle_measure.description: Phase coefficient (presidential-cycle difference), damped drift d_h = b0 + b1 (k_max + sum_{j<=h} damp^j) and per-industry step variance of one measure.

cycle_growth.description: IBISWorld annual REAL (constant-dollar) revenue growth by reference year, 2023..2027, as fractions.

cycle_pace_cycle.description: Dollars of one completed cycle: F the full cycle, O15 / O18 / O21 the amount dated on or before March 31 / June 30 / September 30 of the election year.

g_prior.description: The prior-cycle growth (percent) of the share models for the horizon that has no history row: industry -> cycle -> percent.

cycle_model.description: Cycle-aware 50/50 projection parameters (owner rulings 2026-10-07). Optional: the calculator takes the cycle path only when it is present.
